base_note: based on the head of open PR #1363 (pending); protected main is 79b5d50c

tested_source.diagnostic_only: the probe, the ridge readout, the servable repricing and the decode ladder are float diagnostics over recorded states; none of them is a serving path or a product dependency, and no sealed artifact is modified

question: Is the ~1.56-bit deficit to the tuned two-token count reference a limit of the model's served recurrent state, or of its trained output layer?

method.recording: one walk per window mirroring TlModel::score_example for a non-grounded example; every recorded state is the exact vector the served readout receives
instrument_controls: recorded bit sums equal score_example's own bits_generate; recorded state counts equal its scored Generate targets
corpus control: every recorded state's (cur, prev) equals (tokens[k-1], tokens[k-2]) of its window
null probe: the identical fit on permuted fit labels must sit at the restricted unigram
decode chance floors reported beside every decode accuracy
method.independent_review: the instrument was re-specified after an independent architecture review that corrected two errors: a linear readout cannot in general reach a full count table (rank bound), and the actionable comparison is the converged readout P versus the artifact's own readout A, not P versus the count anchor C

artifact.note: the artifact is read, hashed and probed in place; this attempt records its identity and neither writes to nor re-seals the artifact's own directory

restricted_population.source: top-K token ids by fit-position target frequency over the fit windows actually used, count descending then lowest id first

float_probe.init: W and b start at the closed-form ridge solution fitted on this split's states                       (and, for the null probe, at the ridge solution for the permuted labels), with                       fresh Adam moments, so the epochs refine a converged readout instead of fitting a                       marginal from zero
float_probe.convergence_note: the fit loss is still falling by 0.0738 bits/target at the last epoch, so the probe dev number is a lower bound on what this readout would reach with a longer schedule

state_recording_control.coverage: development is complete; the fit side is a declared stride sample plus every terminal window, because the control is a second full readout pass
state_recording_control.definition: the sum of the recorded per-position bits equals score_example's own bits_generate over the same windows, and the recorded state count equals its scored Generate targets

consumed_token_bookkeeping.control: for every position of both splits, cur must equal tokens[k-1] and prev must equal tokens[k-2] of the containing window, the exact pair the tuned count reference conditions on; any off-by-one aborts the run
consumed_token_bookkeeping.definition: cur = the token consumed by the transition that produced h, prev = the token consumed by the transition before it, both read off the walk's own consumption history with None for a Stop
consumed_token_bookkeeping.off_by_one_risk: a state at the window head has eight observed tokens behind it and so still has both; only a walk that skipped the unrecorded Stop advance, or that read the emitted token instead of the consumed one, can shift the pair, and both of those fail this control

probe_initialisation.artifact: the artifact's own served readout, dequantised into the probe's feature layout. Mapping, exactly: the probe's input is [h / h_clamp, event one-hot] (d) and the artifact's readout input is [h, m, f, event] (2*h_dim + f_dim + 4) through a per-row-scaled ternary map plus an i32 bias bo. (i) state columns 0..h_dim are taken as (w << shift) * h_clamp, the factor h_clamp undoing the probe's own 1 / h_clamp input scaling; (ii) event columns 2*h_dim + f_dim .. + 4 are taken unscaled; (iii) the h_dim m columns are dropped entirely because m is identically zero for ordinary prose, so they contribute exactly zero; (iv) the f_dim columns of the constant typed block are folded into b as sum_f (w_(r,f) << shift_(r)) * f0[f]; (v) the artifact's bo of the same row is added into b; (vi) every coefficient is multiplied by 2^-score_shift, the artifact's declared dyadic score scale, so the initial logits are the SERVED logits in float form. Every coefficient is read from the artifact's own float evaluation of its packed map (TlLinear::forward_reference on unit vectors), so no packing or dequantisation convention is reimplemented
probe_initialisation.epoch_zero_note: the refinement prints and records its fit/dev loss at the declared initialisation before any epoch; with --probe-init artifact that number is the artifact's own readout evaluated in the probe's K-class softmax at the artifact's declared dyadic scale, which is the directly comparable baseline for the probe's own losses (the artifact's served reference A is normalised over its full legal action set instead)

rearrangement_control.definition: on real recorded states the initialised readout's logits must equal TlModel::readout's logits at the artifact's declared dyadic scale, entry by entry; a deviation above 1e-6 aborts the run

probe_initialisation.ridge: the closed-form least-squares readout of the recorded states, fitted on this run's fit split (the P_ridge row above)
probe_initialisation.row_of_class: token_row(top_ids[c]): the artifact readout row of the c-th restricted class

smoke_scale_validation.note: top-k 64 covers 46% of development targets: a subpopulation of the most frequent targets, not the decision population. The artifact-init smoke is the normalisation-matched one: its epoch-0 value is the artifact's own readout under the probe's K-class normalisation, so the drop to the refined value is a fitting headroom with no normalisation confound.

normalisation_convention.artifact_and_count_references: losses over the artifact's full legal action set or the count model's full vocabulary, restricted to the retained targets; these are directly comparable with each other
normalisation_convention.probe_and_repricing: losses under the probe's K-class softmax, which removes the mass the restriction drops and is therefore NOT comparable with the full-set references; compare a probe value only with the artifact-init probe's own epoch-0 value or another probe value
normalisation_convention.declared: the first full-population instrument report compared across these two conventions; the artifact-initialised run was added specifically to remove that confound

limitations: scoped to the probed artifact under the served window conditioning and teacher-forced states
the probe is a linear readout of the state, so its loss is an upper bound on what a linear readout extracts and not a bound on nonlinear readouts
no per-document cluster interval is computed for the probe quantities; the paired-by-position comparison and the measured matched-arm noise scale on this population are the uncertainty argument
coverage is the restriction to the top-K target classes and is reported per run
sampling, donor adaptation, broader conversation and executed Rust remain NOT_RUN; energy remains UNAVAILABLE
